stability_definition: Frequency across available horizons with rank <= 15.

direction_analysis.rule: Risk-Increasing if CI_low>0; Risk-Decreasing if CI_high<0; else Mixed/Uncertain.
direction_analysis.pooling: Pooled patient-horizon rows across all available horizons within each outcome.

notes: SHAP magnitude is on the DeepSurv risk probability scale.
Baseline table is derived from mean base_values per horizon.
Stability metrics are horizon-based, not bootstrap-based.
Direction labels are exploratory and not causal.
